correctness.rationale: For every existing affine plane q>=2, point–line incidence BB^T=qI+J and the metric blocks (point distances 2; line distances 2 or 4 by parallelism; cross 1/3) decompose the zero-sum quadratic form orthogonally. A q-dimensional line parallel-class contrast has coefficient h=(q-1)4^p-q2^p, vanishing exactly at p*=log2(q/(q-1)) and positive for larger p. At this p*, for q>=3 the q²-1 mixed 2x2 sector has determinant >=a(a-2)^2>0 (a=q/(q-1)), and the global sector F<q(a-2)<0; exactly q null directions. For q=2, point singleton/line pair indicator vectors realize squared metric in R^4, with five-dimensional zero-sum nullspace. Lower strictness follows from standard strict p-negative-type inheritance, centered Schoenberg Gram gives interior rank N-1, endpoint 2q²-1 (or 4). Independent Gram eigenchecks at q=2,3,5 confirm nullity (excluding the single constant-vector trivial zero). The proof applies to non-Desarguesian planes, unlike field-only tests.
